codeReview.summary: The implementation correctly modifies the CustomerGroupService.delete() method to sync individual member deletions. Before deleting members, it queries all current members of the group using the customerGroupMembers table, then for each member queues a delete sync operation with entityTypeOverride='customer_group_members' and the member's UUID as entityId. The implementation follows the same pattern used in addMembers() and removeMember() methods which already use individual sync operations.
